messages:
Sam: Quick Q — doing a latency deep-dive for the payments inference path. Where do I find p50/p95/p99, TTFT, and tokens/sec dashboards/traces? Also if anyone has example PromQL for TTFT by model that'd be great.
Anya: Hey @Sam — main places: Grafana 'Inference Latency' (panel list below), 'Token throughput' dashboard, Jaeger service traces, and Loki for request logs. Dashboards: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/6Vq4tt/ttft-and-latency and https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/9Xk2d/token-throughput. Traces: https://jaeger.internal.redwood.com/search?service=inference-runtime . Logs: https://logs.internal.redwood.com/query?query=service%3Dinference-runtime
Anya: Example PromQL for p95 TTFT (histogram):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))
```
For p50/p99 just change 0.95. If your code doesn't emit a histogram, use summary_quantile or use `quantile_over_time` on the sample metric.
Leo: How are we measuring tokens/sec? ingress vs model emitter? If I'm debugging a specific model I want the emitter-side rate.
Anya: tokens/sec canonical metric is `tokens_emitted_total` (counter) and we do a rate over 1m or 5m, split by model/host:
```
rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]) by (model)
```
If you want end-to-end tokens/sec (client->response) use `requests_tokens_total` which is the per-request token count summed over time.
Maureen: For alerting: we bumped p95 TTFT alert last week, here's a starter expression (fine-tune by route):
```
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > 1.2
for: 5m
labels: severity=page
```
Set threshold to ~1.0s for interactive routes, 1.5–2.0s for batch/async. Also exclude warmup spikes or add a low-traffic guard to avoid noisy false positives, e.g. `and on(route) (sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route) > 0.1)`.
Sam: Any panel names I should look for on the dashboard? I keep missing the right one.
Anya: Panels to check: 'TTFT p50/p95/p99 by route', 'Tokens/sec by model', 'TTFT distribution heatmap', 'Recent slow traces (Jaeger)'. There's a quick links row at the top of the dashboard. Runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/latency-ttft-debug (has step-by-step and common causes).
